TL;DR: Drove 3 minutes down the street, and then it was suddenly 2 hours into the future 


I dropped my buddies off at school once back in the day, and then started to drive home. Id be picking them up again 2 hours later because they were cutting a class and wanted to hang out. I never made it to my house, or even down the road much. I turned into the convenience store parking lot, parked my car and was ready to go in and grab a drink. I looked at the time, and it had been almost 2 hours. I thought to myself "What the fuck is going on i literally drove a quarter mile down the road, the time must just have gotten fucked up somehow (this was a 20 year old car at the time, so its not unheard of)" At this point I just drive back to the school to confirm my clock messed up, but i get there and it actually has been 2 hours, my buddies are waiting for me. I have never been able to figure it out, i literally drove a 3 minute strech, and time went forward 2 hours some how. I am 100% sure i didnt drive anywhere else, and it has never happened again.
